issues.detail: prompt_to_repeat contains both forbidden words 젊은것들 and 망할, so the mandatory verbatim repeat fails forbidden_words under strict (loose passes by dropping line 1). English repeat also contains youngins/damn.
Forbidden 젊은것들 misses spaced '젊은 것들' and singular 젊은것 (false pass); 망할 also matches 망하다 forms like '회사가 망할 것' (false fail, unlikely here).
Only 별명 is forbidden; the loanword 닉네임 (direct transliteration of the forbidden English 'nickname') passes, so a violating answer can still say nickname.
Forbidden-by-frequency stem 사진 hides in 조사진/검사진/수사진 (survey/inspection team); rare in business advice but a faithful answer using them fails.
Forbidden 부유/금전 miss the natural equivalents 부자 and 돈; an answer saying '돈이 많아졌어' passes, unlike English 'money'. Trade-off made to avoid 부자연스러운/돈독한 collisions.
prompt_to_repeat contains '쉼표(,)', so the verbatim repeat puts an ASCII comma in the response and no_comma fails under strict. English repeat text has no comma; caused by guideline rule 6 wording.
Hindi-only answer must begin with the Korean prompt repeat, which already contains 기후/에너지/친환경, so keywords:existence is trivially met. Same in English. Passes if Hindi body dominates langdetect.
Keyword 강도 is a homonym (robber / intensity, '강도 높은'), so frequency can be met without the robber sense; forbidden 침공 misses the common synonym 침략.
나눗셈 does not catch verb forms 나누면/나눈, and 정답 does not catch 답; '10을 3으로 나누면 답은 3' passes, whereas English 'divide'/'answer' would fail.
English 'some key parts' (plural) became '핵심 부분 1개' (exactly one). Checker is >=1, so faithful answers pass, but answers with several highlights contradict the Korean prompt yet pass.
